name: aso
title: ASO Scanner MCP
description: Free Agent Readiness scanner as an MCP server. Measures the ASO Score across discovery, identity, trust, commerce, reputation, and memory, and includes a deterministic no-spend x402 v2 endpoint audit.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Full ASO scan: Agent Readiness Report with score, level, pillar breakdown, and all 34 checks.

tools.name: list_checks

tools.name: get_aso_framework
